mapper.select: SELECT w.wanted_id AS wantedId, w.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, w.title AS title, w.category_id AS categoryId, w.budget_min AS budgetMin, w.budget_max AS budgetMax, w.campus AS campus, w.description AS description, w.status AS status, w.response_count AS responseCount, w.create_time AS createTime, w.update_time AS updateTime FROM wanted_post w LEFT JOIN `user` u ON w.user_id = u.user_id WHERE w.wanted_id = #{wantedId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wanted_post ( user_id, title, category_id, budget_min, budget_max, campus, description, status, response_count ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{categoryId}, #{budgetMin}, #{budgetMax}, #{campus}, #{description}, 1, 0 )
mapper.update:
UPDATE wanted_post
title = #{title},
category_id = #{categoryId},
budget_min = #{budgetMin},
budget_max = #{budgetMax},
campus = #{campus},
description = #{description},
WHERE wanted_id = #{wantedId}
